Q5786.reason: The pedestrian’s post-accident refusal of treatment limits recovery under the avoidable-consequences doctrine, but the driver remains liable for the initial wound and suffering.

Q5787.reason: Deliberately firing a gun at a person demonstrates an extreme indifference to human life, supporting depraved-heart murder.

Q5789.reason: The manager’s statement concerned a matter within the scope of employment and qualifies as a statement by an opposing party under FRE 801(d)(2)(D).
